Known issue from transcript:
- hashlib.sha3_256 uses SHA3 padding, not Keccak padding
- Keccak-256 requires 0x01 + zeros + 0x80 at end of message, then 0x06 at rate-1
- This is why the verifier rebuilds kept failing
